description: The numerical golden of rdy's model-free vectors: fixed constants, log2 cases and a fixed store of blocks, with the exact bits of every idf, target weight, norm and unit-vector entry. Values are binary64 bits in hex. Never regenerate them at test time.

store.about: What a store of these blocks gives through its own reads: under like, each content source's like hits in the reply's order, each with its shown score, its exact score bits, its words and its links; under relevance, the order and scores of one sort relevance query; under advice, the briefing rows (with exact score bits) and a write receipt of the fixed project in tests/engine_read/engine_vector_determinism.rs. Ids are as written; created ids are named by their placeholders.
